verdicts.reason: A: the body copy is squeezed into a 4-line column that nearly touches the 20% off headline. The legal text also wraps to 4 lines at the same size as the body copy, so it competes with the message. The product can is tiny, and the peach circle is cut away from it and floats as a stray blob at the far right edge. B: reads cleanly left to right (one-line headline and body, product in its circle, CTA on the right), but the legal text under the CTA is too small to read. WEEKEND ONLY is small and jammed against the top edge, and there is a dead gap between the body copy and the product.
